d: The Floor Organiser is responsible for ensuring a smooth and enjoyable guest experience within the Foodhall.
This role focuses on welcoming guests, assisting them with seating, guiding them through the cuisine options,
POD locations and QR-code menus, while maintaining cleanliness and organization across the dining area.
The Floor Organiser plays a key role in maintaining high service standards by supporting guests throughout
their visit, ensuring tables are properly prepared, and coordinating with other team members to ensure
efficient operations during both peak and non-peak periods.
q: Previous experience in restaurants, cafés, food halls, or hospitality environments is preferred but not
Experience in customer service roles is considered an advantage
Good organizational skills with attention to cleanliness and table setup
Ability to assist guests with digital ordering systems and QR technology
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced service environment
Positive attitude with strong teamwork abilities
Energetic and proactive in assisting guests and supporting colleagues
Ability to remain calm and professional during busy service period
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
Ability to carry and lift moderate weight related to table setup and clearing
